authority.source: explicit human direction to use native subagents exclusively and record harness limitations truthfully
authority.message_id_note: No provider message identifier is available or fabricated.
authority.decision_owner: root orchestrator acting under current human direction

scope.applies_to: the evidence standard for native-subagent fresh-context and reviewer-isolation evidence in this T6 successor lifecycle
does_not_amend: factual claim, denominator, hash, browser, or truth-gate requirements
the immutable status or bytes of full-cohort-independent-review-v1.json
the requirement for a distinct full-cohort reviewer and a separately owned successor review receipt

immutable_predecessor.preservation: The review and its two findings remain unchanged historical evidence. This direction neither edits, relabels, nor retrospectively passes the review.

orchestrator_must_record: native subagent role and bounded output scope
review output and separately owned native receipt paths plus hashes
commands actually run and their observed results

replacement_evidence_standard.sufficiency: For this harness, the native orchestration record together with the retained review and native receipt is sufficient evidence of the required fresh-context and role separation. It replaces the obsolete provider-attestation-or-raw-export condition for T6 F002 only.
not_equivalent_to: proof of an encrypted prompt's contents
a claim about unexposed provider session, ancestry, fork, event, or response identifiers

unavailable_fields: provider event, timing, and final-response identifiers
provider_limitations.single_disclosure: These fields are unavailable from the harness. They must remain null or explicitly unavailable in native receipts; they must never be inferred, reconstructed, or fabricated. This is the sole provider-limitations disclosure for the successor lifecycle.

T6-COHORT-F002.reason: The only unresolved requirement in F002 was provider-attested/raw-export proof that this native harness cannot expose. This direction adopts the available native fork_turns=none orchestration evidence and truthful unavailable provider fields as the sufficient forward-looking standard.
T6-COHORT-F002.predecessor_artifacts: No Batch A or Batch B review artifact is mutated or backfilled. The successor full-cohort reviewer will create its own native receipt under the replacement standard.

T6-COHORT-F001.reason: A fresh full-cohort review must precede every successor candidate, acceptance, and accepted manifest.

authorization_boundary.next_action: A new dedicated native full-cohort adversarial reviewer must independently re-derive the listed inputs and publish a successor review and receipt under this direction.
